column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other in English, one form for Korean.
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in neutral Korean,
# using the terms Korean-speaking users of creative software know. The user is addressed in the
# polite 합니다/하세요 register, as in current Korean software. Where a placeholder takes an object
# particle, both forms are given ("{name}을(를)"), the usual convention for software strings.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft,
# WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft, SoundCraft, FigCraft), "GitHub", "Discord".
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc).
# Korean has one plural form. Shown with the system's Korean font (see cjk_font.rs); where the
# system has none, the interface stays in English.
